description: Order fixture was never created because the setup POST returned 422 and the test ignored it.
howSeeded: Tightened validation so the fixture payload's currency field became mandatory, leaving the test's unchecked setup call failing.
decidingEvidence: The 422 on the setup POST, which the test neither asserted on nor logged.
twinAxis: Both surface as a bad fixture downstream. Here the setup call visibly failed and the test carried on.
